entry.title: 4.11.484 - Leaner shader graphs and faster instancers
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Hue/Saturation/Value becomes a single Arnold color-correct node for any color range.
  • Improved (Maya): Image textures read their own UV set directly, so UV Map nodes no longer add extra Maya nodes.
  • Improved (Maya): Displacement now drives Arnold scalar displacement along the object normal, with Midlevel as the zero point.
  • Improved (Maya): Shared texture placement nodes are labelled with the Blender Mapping node they come from.
  • Improved (Maya): Point instancers from scene transfers build much faster on large scatters.

entry.title: 4.11.483 - Snappier import progress
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Import progress no longer forces a viewport redraw on every update, so big imports finish sooner.

entry.title: 4.11.482 - Tidier instancing groups
entry.content: • Fixed (Maya): PointClouds and Prototypes helper groups are hidden as groups, so their contents stay visible when you need them.

entry.title: 4.11.481 - Shader accuracy pass
entry.content:
• Fixed (Maya): Gamma matches Cycles for linked and negative inputs (Gamma 0 renders white, as in Blender).
  • Fixed (Maya): Subsurface color is left unconnected when Subsurface Weight is 0, avoiding needless nodes.
  • Improved (Maya): Every rebuilt Maya shading node is tagged with the Blender node it reproduces.
  • Improved (Maya): An identity Mapping node passes its vector straight through instead of adding nodes.
  • Fixed (Maya): Missing-image Alpha placeholders can be connected again.
  • Fixed (Maya): Static scatter particles no longer behave like dynamics on timeline changes.

entry.title: 4.11.480 - Cleaner math and steadier progress
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Float math stays single-channel and colors convert per node, giving smaller, more faithful graphs.
  • Improved (Blender): Export Dismiss is now a compact icon so stage labels fit.
  • Fixed (Blender): Export progress only moves forward across phases.

entry.title: 4.11.479 - Keep scene materials
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Keep scene materials skips rebuilding materials for kept objects and retains their full upstream graph.
  • Fixed (Maya): The import confirmation dialog closes before the import starts.

entry.title: 4.11.477 - Split-material instancing
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Geometry Nodes prototypes split by material become a single group instancer.

entry.title: 4.11.475 - Object instance prototypes
entry.content: • Fixed (Maya): Each Geometry Nodes Object reference keeps its own prototype instead of collapsing into one.

entry.title: 4.11.474 - Exact native instancing
entry.content:
• New (Maya): Every Geometry Nodes mesh occurrence is instanced natively in Maya, with no placed mesh copies.
  • Fixed (Maya): Instancer shear and collapsed scales carry over exactly.

entry.title: 4.11.473 - Volumes and instancing owners
entry.content:
• Fixed (Maya): Principled Volume connects to the shading group's Volume Shader slot.
  • Improved (Maya): Imported instancing owners are grouped under a plain transform.

entry.title: 4.11.471 - Smoother re-imports
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Imports go straight through when nothing from the previous import is left in the scene.

entry.title: 4.11.470 - No stray selection sets
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Static scene transfers no longer create selection sets.

entry.title: 4.11.467 - Cleaner Maya panel
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Removed helper-text labels from the scene transfer panel.

entry.title: 4.11.466 - No role display layers
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Static scene transfers no longer add role display layers to your scene.

entry.title: 4.11.464 - Scene transfer is out of Experimental
entry.content:
• Improved (Blender, Maya): Maya scene transfers drop the Experimental label.
  • Improved (Blender): The UV option is now called Skip Inactive UV Maps.

entry.title: 4.11.463 - Replace on first import
entry.content: • Improved (Maya): Scene transfers replace same-named Maya objects on first import, just like FBX.

entry.title: 4.11.462 - Import dialog refresh
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Import dialog gains an Advanced section and a clearer script path layout.
  • Improved (Maya): Editable Rig imports show Importing Geometry while geometry loads.
  • New (Blender): New Include FBX Option preference (off by default).

entry.title: 4.11.461 - Simpler export settings
entry.content: • Improved (Blender): Maya export settings are simplified: rarely changed options are locked to sensible defaults.

entry.title: 4.11.460 - Native Noise
entry.content:
• Improved (Maya): Noise Texture distortion uses Arnold's own noise distortion.
  • Improved (Maya): Distorted and fractional-detail Noise rebuild from a couple of native nodes instead of large math networks.
  • Improved (Maya): Scalar graph results skip an unnecessary color conversion.

entry.title: 4.11.458 - Native shader graph overhaul
entry.content:
• New (Blender): Shader Editor highlights which nodes convert to Maya, with per-node support notes and partial conversions marked yellow.
  • New (Blender): New QuickExport World panel in Properties > World.
  • New (Maya): Shared meshes arrive as native Maya point instancers.
  • New (Maya): Object Info Random carries over for objects and instances.
  • New (Maya): Editable rebuilds for Wave, Radial gradient, Voronoi, Checker, RGB Curves, Clamp, Map Range (all modes), Fresnel and Layer Weight.
  • Improved (Maya): Normal Map, Bump and Displacement chains rebuild as one native graph; Bump distance respects scene units.
  • Improved (Maya): Mix and Add Shader trees convert as nested closures, keeping their factors and transparency.
  • Improved (Maya): Noise fBM rebuilds as a single native Arnold noise node; constant nodes are folded away.
  • Improved (Maya): Textures follow the Blender image color space, including on data sockets.
  • Improved (Blender, Maya): Orthographic camera framing and lens shift survive the transfer.
  • Fixed (Maya): Geometry is kept when an individual material fails to convert.
  • Fixed (Maya): Long Windows texture paths no longer break Arnold texture conversion.
  • Fixed (Blender): Invalid imports cancel with a clear warning.
  • Fixed (Blender, Maya): Isolated mesh vertices are kept without turning into rendered spheres.
